packageRules.description: `n8n-node lint` (@n8n/node-cli) is the lint n8n requires of verified community nodes, and its toolchain is eslint 9: node-cli 0.50.4 depends on eslint 9.29.0 and on eslint-plugin-n8n-nodes-base ^1.16.7, which calls `context.getFilename()` and throws under eslint 10 (https://github.com/beliq-eu/n8n-nodes-beliq/pull/38), and @n8n/eslint-plugin-community-nodes peers eslint 9.29.0. package.json cannot force a newer plugin in, because n8n's scanner rejects an `overrides` field. Lift when @n8n/node-cli depends on eslint 10.

vitest stays on 4 for now. The hold was added because vitest 5 requires `@types/node ^22.0.0 || >=24.0.0`, and this repo pinned `@types/node ^20` to track a Node 20 engines floor. The floor is now `node >=22` with `@types/node ^22`, so that reason is gone. Take vitest 5 as its own change, with its own CI run, and remove this rule in it.

`@types/node` tracks this repo's engines floor, `node >=22` in package.json, so a major past 22 would type development against Node APIs the package does not promise to its users. Raise it together with engines.node. The floor is a per-repo fact, so this stays out of the shared preset.

Node is capped below 27 in the workflows. CI runs Node 26, and the `node-version` matrix also tests the engines floor in package.json. Node 27 is not an LTS release, so the next move is to 28, in every beliq repository at once rather than in this one alone. The github-actions manager reads setup-node's `node-version:` input as depName `node` with packageName `actions/node-versions`, and `matchPackageNames` matches the packageName, so `actions/node-versions` is the name that holds the `node-version:` lines.

Auto-merge minor updates too, once the required checks pass. The default branch of this repository carries a required status check set (the guard checks and the repository's own test check), so a green pull request means named checks ran and passed, not that nothing ran. Measured on 2026-11-02 with `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rules/branches/main`; check it again before copying this rule to another repository. The two rules below take exceptions out, so they have to stay below this one.

No automerge for a version typed into a workflow's `with:` input (dep type `uses-with`), such as `python-version` or setup-uv's `version`. Renovate files a runtime move like Python 3.12 to 3.15 as `minor`, and the test matrix may not cover the new version yet. A group that holds one of these is left for a person to merge.
No automerge for a dependency still below 1.0.0. Under semver a 0.x minor step may break, and Renovate files it as `minor`, for example uv 0.12 to 0.13.
